question: Does Blender 5.2's CENTER override_pixel_jitter_sample intervention produce one frozen decoded RGB identity both within and across fresh processes while the matched NATURAL control reproduces within-PID switching between the two B28 modes?

evidenceBasis.derivationObservation: One NATURAL PID produced both frozen natural modes across twelve calls. CENTER, POS_QUARTER and NEG_QUARTER were each internally exact in one PID, while each fixed position produced a distinct full-frame sampling result. The prewritten selection rule nominated CENTER for confirmatory testing.

sourceCodeEvidence.observation: Sampling::init reads scene custom property override_pixel_jitter_sample; when present it replaces the filter U/V sample dimensions and also derives additional sample dimensions from the supplied values.

design.type: interleaved NATURAL versus CENTER fixed-jitter intervention across fresh persistent Blender processes
design.frameSetRule: Set frame 38 once before the first render and do not change it between calls.
design.renderRule: Call bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True) exactly twelve times per fresh process and write call-01.png through call-12.png.
design.controlRule: NATURAL must delete override_pixel_jitter_sample if present; CENTER must set it to exactly [0.0, 0.0] before the first render.

primaryEndpoint.name: strictFixedJitterStabilityWithActiveNaturalControl
primaryEndpoint.centerExactDefinition: Every CENTER call in every CENTER PID must match the frozen CENTER_DERIVATION decoded RGB hash.
primaryEndpoint.naturalSwitchDefinition: A NATURAL PID switches when its twelve calls include both frozen NATURAL_REFERENCE and NATURAL_ALTERNATE hashes.
primaryEndpoint.centerNovelRule: Any CENTER decoded RGB hash outside CENTER_DERIVATION is preserved as evidence and takes CENTER_VARIATION; it is never coerced or averaged.
primaryEndpoint.naturalNovelRule: Any NATURAL decoded RGB hash outside the two frozen natural hashes is preserved and takes NATURAL_MODE_SPACE_EXPANDED.

secondaryEndpoints: decoded RGB hash frequencies by cell, PID and call ordinal
within-PID adjacent transition counts and directions in each cell
CENTER container hashes and render times despite decoded identity
natural switching-PID count and natural mode totals
number and frequency of novel hashes by cell
descriptive fixed-versus-natural image-change metrics copied from the frozen derivation, not reoptimized

decisionRule.NATURAL_MODE_SPACE_EXPANDED: The valid NATURAL cell observes a decoded RGB hash outside its two frozen hashes.
decisionRule.CENTER_VARIATION: No natural novel hash occurs, but one or more CENTER calls depart from the frozen CENTER_DERIVATION decoded RGB hash.
decisionRule.FIXED_JITTER_STRICT_STABILITY_SUPPORT: No prior failure occurs, all 144 CENTER calls across 12 CENTER PIDs equal CENTER_DERIVATION, and at least two NATURAL PIDs each contain both frozen natural modes.
decisionRule.NATURAL_SINGLE_PID_SWITCH_INCONCLUSIVE: No prior failure occurs, all CENTER calls are exact, and exactly one NATURAL PID contains both natural modes.
decisionRule.NATURAL_WITHIN_PID_SWITCH_NOT_REPRODUCED: No prior failure occurs, all CENTER calls are exact, and no NATURAL PID contains both natural modes.
decisionRule.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: Any identity, source, control, process, call, output, layout, binding, frozen-contract, attack or human-status gate fails.

requiredNegativeCases: source state or fixed render-control mismatch
PID uniqueness or cell binding mismatch
classification, manifest or file-hash binding mismatch
hash-set, sample-size, threshold, precedence or decision-rule mutation
explicitNonClaims: Strict CENTER stability would support this intervention for one scene, frame, Blender build, backend and machine; it would not prove universal determinism.
Changing override_pixel_jitter_sample changes the sampling target across the full frame and is not a quality-preserving repair of the seventeen-pixel natural event.
The intervention also derives additional sample dimensions from the supplied values, so a positive result would not isolate filter U/V jitter as the sole causal dimension.
The fixed CENTER image has not been established as perceptually superior, anti-aliased, temporally acceptable or cinematic.
Twelve processes per cell and twelve calls per process are a fixed mechanistic probe, not a population equivalence or failure-probability bound.
Decoded RGB identity does not replace EXR mastering checks or the independent PENDING human-review gate.
